Secy. Home Lko on 12 November, 2024

Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:74536
Court No. - 11
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2516 of 2024
Applicant :- Sanjay Singh @ Sanjay Kumar Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard Shri Ramakar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Bhanu Pratap Singh,
learned A.G.A. for the State
2.

As per learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is apprehending his arrest in Case
Crime No.0382 of 2020, under Sections 147, 148, 308, 394, 452, 504 I.P.C., at Police Station -
Pisawan, District - Sitapur.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as he has not committed any offence as alleged in the prosecution story.

sentences.text: Attention of the Court has been drawn towards Annexure No.4, which is an order being passed by this Court in Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. 429 of 2021 , granting anticipatory bail to the applicant on 17.02.2021 till filing of the charge sheet.

4. Per contra, Shri Bhanu Pratap Singh, learned A.G.A. has opposed the second anticipatory bail and submitted that the applicant should surrender before the learned trial court concerned by filing his regular bail application.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant co-operated in the investigation and did not misuse the liberty of bail.
Later on charge sheet has been filed in the present case on 3rd March, 2021.
The aforesaid anticipatory bail application has been dismissed for want of prosecution on 15.03.2021 (Annexure No.5 to the application).

Learned counsel for the applicant Shri Ramakar Shukla, has submitted that the law is trite on the subject in Re : Siddharth Vs. State of U.P. and another, reported in (2022) 1 SCC 676; Aman Preet Singh Vs. C.B.I. through Director, in Criminal Appeal No. 929 of 2021 [arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.5234 of 2021], and Mahdoom Bava Vs. Central Burea of Investigation, [arising out of SLP (Crl.) NO.376 of 2023,
decided on 20th March, 2023], whereby the Apex Court has held that if any accused person cooperated in the investigation, after getting any protection from the competent court, and did not flout such liberty, after filing of the charge sheet his arrest may not be warranted, unless there is specific reason to keep such accused person under custody.

entities.text: Siddharth Vs. State of U.P. and another, reported in (2022) 1 SCC 676
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Mahdoom Bava Vs. Central Burea of Investigation
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Shri Ramakar Shukla has, therefore,
submitted that the applicant is ready to appear/surrender before the learned trial court concerned by filing his appropriate application for bail, etc. and that such application may be considered and disposed of in terms of the aforesaid dictums of Hon'ble Apex Court.

6. Having considered the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and having perused the material available on record, considering the request of Shri Ramakar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, this second anticipatory bail application is disposed of finally, at this stage, giving liberty to the applicant to appear/surrender before the trial court concerned and file his regular bail application, within a period of two weeks, and if such bail application is filed, the same shall be considered and disposed of by the trial court concerned, with expedition, without giving any unnecessary adjournment to any of the parties, in the light of the dictum in Re:Siddharth Vs. State of U.P. and another, reported in (2022) 1 SCC 676, Aman Preet Singh Vs. C.B.I. through Director,
